OTP Input

OTP Input is used for one-time password verification. It provides individual digit inputs with auto-advance and paste support.

JS Auto-Advance & Paste

Full implementation with auto-advance, backspace navigation, and paste support.

JavaScript
function initOTP(containerId) {
  const container = document.getElementById(containerId);
  const inputs = container.querySelectorAll('.zak-otp-input-field');

  inputs.forEach((input, index) => {
    input.addEventListener('input', function() {
      this.value = this.value.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');
      if (this.value && index < inputs.length - 1) {
        inputs[index + 1].focus();
      }
    });

    input.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
      if (e.key === 'Backspace' && !this.value && index > 0) {
        inputs[index - 1].focus();
        inputs[index - 1].value = '';
      }
      if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' && index > 0) {
        inputs[index - 1].focus();
      }
      if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' && index < inputs.length - 1) {
        inputs[index + 1].focus();
      }
    });

    input.addEventListener('paste', function(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const pasted = (e.clipboardData || window.clipboardData).getData('text').replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');
      pasted.split('').forEach((char, i) => {
        if (inputs[index + i]) {
          inputs[index + i].value = char;
        }
      });
      const lastIndex = Math.min(index + pasted.length, inputs.length) - 1;
      inputs[lastIndex].focus();
    });
  });
}

initOTP('otp-advance');

CSS Classes Reference

ClassDescription
.zak-otp-inputOTP container

.zak-otp-input-separatorVisual separator between groups

Accessibility

  • Each input should have aria-label indicating its position (e.g., "Digit 1 of 6").
  • Use inputmode="numeric" for mobile keyboard optimization.
  • Set autocomplete="one-time-code" for browser autofill support.
  • Announce completion of OTP entry with aria-live.
  • Support paste via clipboard — don't prevent it.
